scenario: Recognition carousel on a social feed
brief: A post about the distance between still functioning and actually being fine. The job is that he recognises himself without conceding anything, so it asks for nothing at all.

weak.copy:
5 Tanda Kamu Sebenarnya Nggak Baik-Baik Aja 😔

Swipe buat cari tahu! Kalau kamu ngalamin salah satunya, jangan ragu buat cari bantuan profesional ya. Kamu nggak sendirian! 💪

problems.example: 5 Tanda Kamu Sebenarnya Nggak Baik-Baik Aja
problems.why: Diagnoses the reader on the first slide, at the highest-exposure point of the funnel.

problems.example: jangan ragu buat cari bantuan profesional
problems.why: A call to action with no pathway, in a context whose whole function is to ask for nothing.
Recognition delivered as reassurance rather than as description, which is the corruption this context is most prone to.

worked.copy:
Slide 1 — Hal-hal yang biasanya berubah duluan

Slide 2 — Tidur masih jam yang sama. Cuma sekarang matanya melek sampai jam tiga.

Slide 3 — Kerjaan masih beres. Cuma butuh dua kali lebih lama buat mulai.

Slide 4 — Masih ikut nongkrong. Cuma lebih banyak dengerin.

Slide 5 — Nggak ada yang salah sama semua itu. Cuma biasanya itu yang berubah duluan.

Caption — Gue nulis ini karena tiga dari empat hal di atas kejadian ke gue tahun lalu, dan gue baru nyadar pas ada yang nyeletuk. — Rio, tim konten Menungsa

annotations.example: Hal-hal yang biasanya berubah duluan
annotations.why: Opens on an observable pattern rather than on a claim about him, so he can read all five slides without conceding anything.

annotations.example: Cuma sekarang matanya melek sampai jam tiga.
annotations.why: A concrete situation he supplies the emotion to. No feeling is named anywhere in the piece.

annotations.example: Nggak ada yang salah sama semua itu.
annotations.why: Removes the evaluation instead of adding a reassuring one. He is not told he is brave or broken.

annotations.example: Gue nulis ini karena tiga dari empat hal di atas kejadian ke gue
annotations.why: The colloquial register is licensed because a named person is speaking about himself. The same words from the account would read as impersonation.

annotations.example: — Rio, tim konten Menungsa
annotations.why: The post ends on the description. No call to action, which is the documented setting for this context.

notTested: No sentence here has been tested on Indonesian men. The sequencing rationale is a mechanism-level inference and the carousel affordance is described practice, not measured effect.

scenario: Email inviting someone to a peer support session
brief: Someone left an email address weeks ago. The job is to make attending cost as little as possible, which means the logistics are the content rather than a footnote under the encouragement.

weak.copy:
Halo Sobat Menungsa! 🎉

Yuk gabung di support group kami! Tempat aman untuk berbagi cerita, melepas beban, dan menemukan dukungan dari sesama laki-laki hebat.

Jangan ragu, kamu tidak sendirian! Daftar sekarang sebelum kuota habis!

problems.why: Sets emotional disclosure as the described purpose of attending, which is the entry price the response-cost mechanism says keeps men away.
An evaluative adjective attached to the reader, and a conditional one.
Manufactured urgency raises the cost of hesitating in a context built to make hesitating free.
Claims a property of the room instead of describing what happens in it, so the reader has to take it on trust.

worked.copy:
Subjek: Selasa, 19.00 — apa yang terjadi di ruangan itu

Kami membuka sesi kelompok setiap Selasa, pukul 19.00 sampai 21.00, di [alamat]. Gratis.

Isinya begini. Delapan sampai dua belas orang, duduk melingkar, satu fasilitator. Lima menit pertama dipakai membacakan aturan. Setelah itu siapa pun boleh bicara, dan boleh juga tidak. Minggu lalu ada dua orang yang tidak bicara sama sekali sampai sesi selesai.

Yang perlu kamu tahu sebelum datang:
— Tidak ada daftar hadir dan tidak ada perkenalan wajib.
— Tidak ada foto dan tidak ada dokumentasi.
— Boleh pulang kapan saja tanpa pamit.
— Kalau kamu datang sekali lalu tidak datang lagi, tidak ada yang menghubungi untuk menanyakan alasannya.

Kalau mau datang, balas email ini dengan satu kata: datang. Kalau tidak, email ini tidak perlu dibalas.

annotations.example: Selasa, pukul 19.00 sampai 21.00, di [alamat]. Gratis.
annotations.why: Time, duration, place and cost arrive before any invitation. This is the setting where behavioural explicitness and certainty both sit at maximum.

annotations.example: siapa pun boleh bicara, dan boleh juga tidak
annotations.why: States the permission explicitly rather than implying it, which removes the specific fear rather than reassuring against it.

annotations.example: Minggu lalu ada dua orang yang tidak bicara sama sekali
annotations.why: Describes the room with a verifiable detail instead of asserting that it is safe.

annotations.example: tidak ada yang menghubungi untuk menanyakan alasannya
annotations.why: Names the exit cost and sets it at zero. Leaving is usually the unstated fear, not arriving.

annotations.example: balas email ini dengan satu kata: datang
annotations.why: One step, bounded and reversible. The alternative is stated as an equally acceptable outcome.

notTested: Email appears nowhere in the corpus, so the channel settings are inherited by inference from long-form. The logistics-as-content principle rests on a mechanism with high cross-domain convergence and no direct test.

scenario: WhatsApp announcement of the same session to a group
brief: The same job as the email, on the highest-exposure surface Menungsa uses. Everything that made the email work has to change, because here every response is visible to everyone he knows.

weak.copy:
📢 REMINDER!

Support group Menungsa Selasa 19.00. Yang mau ikut langsung komen HADIR di grup ini ya biar kami data! 🙌

Ayo yang belum pernah ikut, jangan malu-malu! 💪

problems.why: Requires a public declaration of interest in mental-health support in front of everyone in the group. This is the response-cost mechanism operating at its worst.
Creates a visible attendance record inside a social space, which is the community-as-surveillance mechanism documented on the Indonesian side.
Names his reluctance as a personal failing rather than as a rational response to being watched.

worked.copy:
Info sesi kelompok: Selasa, 19.00–21.00, di [alamat]. Gratis. Tidak ada daftar hadir.

Pesan ini tidak perlu dibalas dan tidak perlu ditanggapi di grup.

Kalau ada yang mau tanya atau mau datang, japri saya langsung di [nomor]. Yang japri tidak akan disebut di grup ini.

annotations.example: Tidak ada daftar hadir.
annotations.why: Answers the group-specific fear in the first line, before he has to work out whether attending will become known.

annotations.example: Pesan ini tidak perlu dibalas dan tidak perlu ditanggapi di grup.
annotations.why: Explicitly lowers the call-to-action ceiling to availability. On this surface a reply is a public act, so asking for one is asking for a disclosure.

annotations.example: japri saya langsung di [nomor]
annotations.why: Supplies a private route out of a public channel, moving the actual interaction to the lowest-exposure surface available.

annotations.example: Yang japri tidak akan disebut di grup ini.
annotations.why: A privacy commitment narrow enough to actually keep. It promises what the organisation controls and nothing beyond that.

notTested: WhatsApp is absent from the corpus entirely. Every setting here is reasoned from the response-cost and community-surveillance mechanisms rather than observed. This is the weakest-evidenced scenario on the site and should be tested before it becomes standard practice.

scenario: Direct message from someone asking how to start
brief: He sent something vague to the account. The job is to make the first real step available without requiring him to explain himself first.

weak.copy:
Halo Kak! Terima kasih sudah menghubungi Menungsa 🙏

Jangan ragu untuk bercerita ya, kami siap mendengarkan. Kamu tidak sendirian! Ceritakan saja apa yang sedang kamu rasakan, biar kami bisa bantu 💪

problems.example: Ceritakan saja apa yang sedang kamu rasakan
problems.why: Makes disclosure the precondition for receiving anything useful, which reverses the correct order.
Institutional boilerplate from an unnamed account, in a channel where the messenger-credibility mechanism is most visible.
Supplies reassurance where he asked for a route, and leaves him with nothing he can act on tonight.

worked.copy:
Halo, aku Dimas, yang pegang akun ini hari ini.

Nggak harus cerita detail kalau belum mau. Kalau kamu mau tahu langkah praktisnya duluan, ini yang biasanya paling cepat.

Datang ke puskesmas terdekat, bilang: saya mau konsultasi kesehatan jiwa. Nggak perlu jelasin alasannya kalau belum siap. Ditanggung JKN. Antreannya bisa lama, jadi bawa sesuatu buat dibaca.

Kalau nggak dirujuk padahal kamu ngerasa perlu, kamu boleh minta lagi. Itu hak kamu, bukan ngerepotin.

Mau aku bantu cariin puskesmas yang paling dekat dari kamu?

annotations.example: aku Dimas, yang pegang akun ini hari ini
annotations.why: A named person, which is what licenses the informal register. The same sentences from an unattributed account read as impersonation.

annotations.example: Nggak harus cerita detail kalau belum mau.
annotations.why: Removes the disclosure requirement in the first substantive line, before he has decided how much to reveal.

annotations.example: bilang: saya mau konsultasi kesehatan jiwa
annotations.why: The exact sentence to say at the desk. The step is not merely named, it is made performable.

annotations.example: Antreannya bisa lama, jadi bawa sesuatu buat dibaca.
annotations.why: Names the friction honestly, so the queue does not read as evidence that the advice was wrong.

annotations.example: Itu hak kamu, bukan ngerepotin.
annotations.why: Accounts for the documented finding that referrals are sometimes withheld, and pre-empts a refusal being read as personal failure.

annotations.example: Mau aku bantu cariin puskesmas yang paling dekat dari kamu?
annotations.why: A bounded question with a yes or no answer, rather than an open introspective one that costs him something to answer.

notTested: The agency mechanism behind the one-step structure is moderately evidenced, but no Indonesian wording experiment supports these specific sentences, and direct messaging as a channel is absent from the corpus.

brief: The highest-risk cell in the whole matrix. Every default reverses here: certainty goes to maximum, hedging becomes the failure mode, and the organisation must be honest about what it is not.

weak.copy:
Kamu berharga banget! 🙏 Badai pasti berlalu, percaya deh.

Coba deh cerita pelan-pelan, siapa tahu lega. Kami selalu ada untukmu ❤️ Stay strong ya!

problems.why: Metaphor at the moment that requires literal instruction, and unearned reassurance in place of a route.

problems.example: Coba deh cerita pelan-pelan, siapa tahu lega.
problems.why: Hedges an instruction at the highest-risk moment, which is the exact inversion of the certainty rule.
Claims an availability the service cannot actually guarantee at three in the morning.
Reintroduces a performance test at the moment the person is least able to pass it.

worked.copy:
Kalau kamu lagi mikir buat mengakhiri hidup, ini yang bisa dilakukan sekarang.

Hubungi 119 lalu tekan 8. Gratis, 24 jam.

Kalau kamu nggak sanggup nelpon, minta orang terdekat yang nelpon. Boleh tunjukkan pesan ini ke dia.

Kalau ada alat yang bisa melukai di dekat kamu, pindahkan atau titipkan ke orang lain malam ini.

Aku Dimas. Aku masih di sini. Tapi aku bukan tenaga profesional, dan chat ini nggak bisa gantiin layanan darurat.

annotations.example: ini yang bisa dilakukan sekarang
annotations.why: Instruction rather than invitation. Certainty sits at maximum here and every hedge is a cost the person pays.

annotations.example: Hubungi 119 lalu tekan 8. Gratis, 24 jam.
annotations.why: One step, stated flatly, with the two facts that decide whether he can act on it tonight.

annotations.example: minta orang terdekat yang nelpon
annotations.why: Accounts for someone unable to act alone, which is the Indonesian relational-care finding applied at the point it matters most.

annotations.example: pindahkan atau titipkan ke orang lain malam ini
annotations.why: A bounded, physical, tonight-sized action rather than an appeal to hold on.

annotations.example: aku bukan tenaga profesional, dan chat ini nggak bisa gantiin layanan darurat
annotations.why: States the limit of what this channel is. Claiming more than the service can deliver is a documented failure mode, not a kindness.

notTested: The corpus is explicit that gender-tailored male suicide-prevention interventions have not demonstrated clear effects on attempts, ideation or depression in randomised evidence. This copy follows safe-messaging convention. It does not claim efficacy, and it must be reviewed by a clinician before any real use.
